name: Kuro Neko
source:
An ordinary black cat that often visits Ichinari's apartment.

[spoiler]Becomes a messenger of the gods, and thus able to speak. Out of gratitude for him taking care of her, she conveys the wishes of Ichinari and his three friends to said gods, who, finding the wishes would otherwise be incompatible, set up the harem situation as a solution.[/spoiler]
